title: Grizzly, Yellow Lantern enderman and blue great white, refined
desc: J, after the round 4 Titan creatures (trials/titan_killer2.blend): "I want grizzly refined, shark and the other i named as well". The Titan trial is shelved, so these are standalone creatures. Real voxel shapes instead of stacked boxes, real detail (faces, claws, fur patches; jointed enderman limbs and stand-off hard-light armour; the shark's torpedo body, gills, teeth and tail) and poses that read, three takes each, all turning. Legs and fins are checked numerically: none cross each other or the floor, planted feet touch it. Glow at or under emission 1.5.

takes.name: Grizzly: swipe
takes.facts: brown coat; on all fours, head low and roaring, the near front paw mid-swipe with five long pale claws out; three paws flat on the ground; shoulder hump, dished face, cheek ruffs, round ears, grizzled patches and shaggy tufts; about 18 blocks long, 10 at the shoulder

takes.name: Grizzly: charge
takes.facts: silvertip coat (dark brown, silver-tipped patches); mid-gallop: one front paw landing, the other about to touch down, a hind foot planted, the other pushing off; mouth open, canines out

takes.name: Grizzly: rearing roar
takes.facts: dark coat; up on its hind legs (about 21 blocks to the ears), both hind feet flat on the ground, arms spread with claws out, head thrown back in a roar

takes.name: Lantern Enderman: block carrier
takes.facts: plates: a black enderman (14 tall) under stand-off yellow hard-light armour (stacked pauldrons, a chest plate with a window onto its gold-framed lantern heart, greaves with lit knee caps, floating back plates), a gold halo; it carries a big fear block (glass, glowing edges, a dark core with a fear-eye slit), four small ones orbiting

takes.name: Lantern Enderman: scream lunge
takes.facts: shards: armour of faceted fear glass (shoulder spikes, barbs on the forearms and spine, knee spikes, a shard crown); a screaming lunge out of a teleport, jaw open on its glow, clawed hands flung back (the ring on its right hand); two afterimages behind it in yellow static; both feet on the ground

takes.name: Lantern Enderman: kneels to charge
takes.facts: lantern cage: gold bars over a glowing heart in its chest, rounded glass pauldrons, a halo; it kneels (one knee on the ground) to charge its ring at its own Yellow Lantern, the ring hand resting on the lantern's port, the other forearm on its raised knee

takes.name: Great White: breach
takes.facts: a 22-block great white breaching out of the flooded room, side-on, jaws open on rows of teeth; steel blue over a ragged white belly line, blue hard-light gill slits, eye rings and trailing fin edges; foam and spray where it leaves the water

takes.name: Great White: banking hunt
takes.facts: hard-light fins: see-through blue fins and tail with glowing trailing edges; banking hard just under the surface, the back and the dorsal fin cutting the water, foam round it

takes.name: Great White: ledge lunge
takes.facts: scarred: pale old scars on the back and a glowing blue line down each side; it hurls itself onto the ledge at you, belly and fins resting on the stone, jaws wide, the tail still in the water
